stemMarkdown: Evaluate $\dfrac{1}{4 + \sqrt{7}}$ as a decimal. (Round to 6 decimal places.)
solutionMarkdown: Multiply top and bottom by the conjugate $4 - \sqrt{7}$: $\dfrac{4 - \sqrt{7}}{4^2 - 7} = \dfrac{4 - \sqrt{7}}{9} = 0.150472$.
altSolutionMarkdown: Rationalising does not change the value — it just moves the irrational part to the numerator.
